episodeTitle.en: How to scrappily hire for, measure, and unlock growth | Crystal Widjaja, Gojek and Kumu
episodeTitle.zh: 何以以低成本招聘、精准衡量并释放增长潜力 | 水晶·维迪雅加（Gojek、Kumu产品负责人）

guestBioOfficial.en: You don't need lots of employees to achieve impressive growth, but you do need a unique approach to hiring and measuring what matters most. Crystal Widjaja has used scrappy tactics to unlock massive success for Gojek (a wildly successful ride-share app in South East Asia) and is currently the Chief Product Officer at Kumu. In this episode, she shares the exact strategies she’s used as a product leader to hack growth, hire the best, and perfect data collection. Join us.
guestBioOfficial.zh: 要实现显著增长，您无需大量员工，但需要采用独特的招聘方式并关注最关键的衡量指标。水晶·维迪雅加曾为Gojek（东南亚极为成功的网约车平台）破解增长难题，如今担任Kumu首席产品官。在本期节目中，她将分享作为产品领导者如何破解增长难题、招聘顶尖人才并优化数据收集的具体策略。欢迎加入我们。

title.en: How to scrappily hire for, measure, and unlock growth | Crystal Widjaja, Gojek and Kumu
title.zh: 何以以低成本招聘、精准衡量并释放增长潜力 | 水晶·维迪雅加（Gojek、Kumu产品负责人）

summary.en: Crystal shares the biggest growth unlocks she's seen across Gojek and other large consumer businesses, and which growth investments pay off versus which don't. She digs into growth models, tips for accelerating growth, and why most analytics efforts fail—and how to avoid that. The conversation also covers how to hire and structure a growth team, plus her nonprofit Generation Girl for getting young women into STEM.
summary.zh: Crystal 分享了她在 Gojek 及其他大型消费业务中所见的最大增长突破，以及哪些增长投入有回报、哪些没有。她深入增长模型、加速增长的技巧，以及为何多数数据分析努力会失败——又如何避免。对话还涵盖如何招聘和搭建增长团队，以及她帮助年轻女性进入 STEM 的非营利项目 Generation Girl。
